profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer,  JavaScript | TypeScript | React | Next.JS |  Node.JS | NestJS | PHP | Laravel | Symfony
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing, developing, and modernizing business-critical backend and web platforms across e-commerce, logistics, healthcare, and inventory domains. Strong hands-on experience building scalable applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue.js, Node.js, NestJS, PHP, Symfony, Laravel, working across monolithic systems, microservices, BFFs, microfrontends, and event-driven architectures. Experienced in API design, system integrations and high-traffic platforms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contribute to the development and modernization of Falabella Seller Center, a business-critical e-commerce platform used by 20,000+ sellers and internal operations teams to manage orders, returns, and logistics operations across Latin America, using React, Next.js, Javascript, TypeScript, NestJs, Php and Symfony.

• Developed business-critical order and logistics features in a PHP monolith built with Symfony and Zend, while also contributing to the development of features in a Node.js microservice. 
• Contributed to the modernization of the order management platform, migrating functionality from the PHP monolith to a React-based microfrontend and NestJS BFF, improving modularity and enabling independent evolution of frontend and backend capabilities. 
• Designed and developed backend services for critical logistics workflows, including webhook-based notifications for API-integrated sellers, logistics label generation, and shipment manifest creation with NestJs.
• Led the migration of the legacy returns platform to a modern microfrontend in Next.js and NestJS BFF architecture, defining the API contract between the frontend and BFF and developing the backend orchestration layer responsible for integrating with downstream services.
• Implemented scalable integration patterns using caching, queue and GCP Pub/Sub, enabling asynchronous and event-driven communication between services.
• Worked on platforms processing 15.7M requests per day, sustaining approximately 160–185 requests per second, scaling to 600–700 RPS during CyberSale events, with a p99 latency of 329 ms.
• Contributed to architecture decisions for new business capabilities, designing technical solutions for complex business workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · PostgreSQL · Docker · Zend Framework · Google pubsub · Next.js · TypeScript · GitHub · MySQL · NestJS · Node.js · Css3 · Symfony Framework · GitLab · React.js · JavaScript · Integración continua y entrega continua (CI/CD) · Jest · PHP · Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Focused on modernizing internal enterprise applications by transitioning from legacy Oracle Forms systems to modern web-based components using JavaScript and Oracle JET. 

• Migrated legacy Oracle Forms processes to modern JavaScript Oracle JET components, enhancing UI usability and maintainability.
• Developed Oracle PL/SQL stored procedures to enforce and support core credit business rules, enhancing data validation and transactional integrity.
• Maintained and optimized PL/SQL business logic for improved system robustness and operational reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented multiple internal business modules critical for warehouse and employee management using PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, TypeScript and Vue.js. Delivered a fully traceable inventory management system to meticulously track stock movements, significantly enhancing operational control and inventory accuracy. Developed HR-focused applications to manage employee medical records and automated notifications for contract expirations.

• Built a warehouse management module in PHP Laravel to achieve comprehensive traceability of inventory transactions and stock levels.
• Developed a medical office management system encompassing employee health records and appointment scheduling using PHP Laravel, JavaScript, TypeScript and Vue.js.
• Implemented automated notification features for HR to track employee contract expiry dates to support timely renewals and compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap · HTML5 · Microsoft SQL Server · TypeScript · Vue.js · MySQL · Laravel · Css3 · JavaScript · PHP

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered end-to-end development for multiple Laravel PHP and Vue.js projects including healthcare and medical supply management platforms. Designed scalable databases and backend algorithms tailored for complex business workflows. Optimized performance via Laravel ORM enhancements and developed interactive user interfaces to facilitate efficient call center operations and supplier management.
• Developed Laravel-based features to manage interactions and workflows for palliative care call centers, improving patient follow-up communications.
• Created dynamic visual reports and charts to display medical follow-up data enhancing healthcare insights.
• Optimized database queries with Laravel ORM to significantly improve the performance and responsiveness of medical supply management applications.
• Designed and implemented core modules for a surgery expense management platform covering medical opinions, reporting, and operational control functionalities.
• Architected and created scalable, maintainable database schemas aligned with business needs to support longterm platform evolution.
• Delivered comprehensive full-stack solutions from database modeling and backend logic to polished frontend interfaces using Laravel, PHP, Vue.js, JavaScript, CSS3, HTML5, and Bootstrap.
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap · HTML5 · GitFlow · TypeScript · Vue.js · MySQL · Laravel Framework · Css3 · JavaScript · Nginx · PHP

positions.title: IT Engineer
positions.description:
We achieved a reduction in failures and incidents in the internal ERP, as well as minimized failures in computer equipment by 90% through the implementation of a maintenance program. Some of the activities carried out include:

Administration of servers in Windows Server 2008, 2003 environments (Proxy, AD DS, and DHCP), Hyper-V
Technical support for the internal ERP both on-site and remotely
Network and switch administration
Preventive and corrective maintenance of computer equipment
Project management and dealing with suppliers
Data analysis using the ScoreCard Simetrical tool.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Development of a web application called 'Programa de Tutorías del ITSU' for diagnosing students with study difficulties. Developed using the PHP programming language with the Laravel 4 framework, HTML5 for markup, CSS3 managed through the Bootstrap 3 framework for responsive design, and JavaScript. Additionally, it includes a connection to a MySQL database.http://tutorias.tecuruapan.edu.mx/inicio
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap · HTML5 · MySQL · Laravel Framework · Css3 · PHP

projects.description: Desarrollo de aplicación de escritorio para registro de ventas compras e inventario en una farmacia en el poblado de San Juan Nuevo, Michoacán. Desarrollada en la plataforma Java SE con conexión a base de datos en MySQL.
